pli-tv-bu-vb-pc52:2.2.10: dukkaṭassa → kāyena kāyapaṭibaddhaṃ āmasati āpatti dukkaṭassa. kāyapaṭibaddhena kāyaṃ āmasati āpatti dukkaṭassa, kāyapaṭibaddhena kāyapaṭibaddhaṃ āmasati āpatti dukkaṭassa, nissaggiyena kāyaṃ āmasati āpatti dukkaṭassa. nissaggiyena kāyapaṭibaddhaṃ āmasati āpatti dukkaṭassa. nissaggiyena nissaggiyaṃ āmasati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
